steps.cmd: [builder 10/11] RUN if [ "false" = "true" ] || [ "false" = "1" ]; then export SCCACHE_RECACHE=1; echo "sccache: forced recache ON — cache reads disabled for this build"; else echo "sccache: normal mode — cache reads enabled"; fi; if [ -z "" ]; then cores=$(nproc); jobs=$(awk -v per="2" '/^MemAvailable:/ {print int($2/1024/1024/per)}' /proc/meminfo); [ -n "${jobs}" ] || jobs=${cores}; [ "${jobs}" -ge 1 ] || jobs=1; [ "${jobs}" -le "${cores}" ] || jobs=${cores}; export MAX_JOBS=${jobs}; echo "MAX_JOBS= (from ${cores} cores, $(awk '/^MemAvailable:/ {printf "%.0fGB", $2/1048576}' /proc/meminfo) available)"; else echo "MAX_JOBS= (pinned via build arg)"; fi; python -m build --wheel --no-isolation --outdir /opt/pytorch/dist 2>&1 | tee /opt/pytorch/build.log && sccache --show-stats | tee /opt/pytorch/sccache-stats.txt; rc=$?; echo "--- sccache error log: $(wc -c < /tmp/sccache-err.log 2>/dev/null || echo absent) bytes ---"; grep -aiE 'cache error|preprocessor failed|cache read error|cache write error|failed to (read|write)' /tmp/sccache-err.log 2>/dev/null | grep -v 'read failed NotFound' | head -60; echo "--- cache misses, first 40 (debug only) ---"; grep -aoE '\[[^]]+\]: Cache miss' /tmp/sccache-err.log 2>/dev/null | head -40; exit $rc
[builder 8/11] RUN pip install --no-cache-dir build && pip install --no-cache-dir --group dev && pip install --no-cache-dir mkl-static mkl-include

[builder 7/11] RUN if sccache --show-stats > /dev/null 2>&1; then echo "sccache: server up, cache = http://100.91.58.37:8081"; elif [ "1" = "1" ]; then echo "ERROR: sccache could not reach http://100.91.58.37:8081." >&2; echo " Check nginx on Strix (sccache-webdav site), and that this" >&2; echo " builder was created with --driver-opt network=host." >&2; echo " Build anyway with --set '*.args.REQUIRE_SCCACHE=0'." >&2; exit 1; else echo "WARNING: no sccache cache; this build will not be cached." >&2; fi

[builder 5/11] RUN tar xzf /tmp/sccache.tar.gz -C /usr/local/bin --strip-components=1 "sccache-v0.19.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl/sccache" && rm /tmp/sccache.tar.gz && chmod +x /usr/local/bin/sccache && sccache --version

[builder 2/11] RUN git clone --depth 1 --branch v2.14.1 --recurse-submodules --shallow-submodules https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch.git /opt/pytorch && cd /opt/pytorch && if [ -n "" ]; then git fetch origin && git checkout && git submodule sync && git submodule update --init --recursive; fi
